hints.title: Divisibility by 25
hints.text: A number is divisible by 25 if and only if it ends with '00', '25', '50', '75', or can be reduced to 0.

hints.title: Rightmost Pair Search
hints.text: For each valid two-digit suffix, scan num from right to left to find the pair with minimal deletion deletions.

hints.title: Zero Fallback
hints.text: If no suffix can be formed, deleting all digits except one '0' takes len(num) - 1 deletions if '0' is present, else len(num).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Constant number of passes scanning right-to-left for candidate suffixes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use suffix divisibility rules for 25 and check rightmost occurrences.
